Name: Pencilstab's White Haired Elliott with Sprites
Author: maybeawriter6
Description:
I fell in love with a very old portrait [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/33124356]Pencilstab[/url] did of Elliott with white hair, so using the only screenshot I could find, I updated the portraits by editing parts of the existing expressions together to make the remaining 3

This does unfortunately mean there's a white background on the portraits, which I can't really do anything about at the moment. Hopefully that isn't too big an issue, however.

I also went ahead and edited matching sprites to match the portraits, swatching colors directly from them and (rather underestimating how hard it would be) manually changed all the colors by hand. (Never again, I will find an easier way to do that, next time XD)

I also gave him some pajamas

I reached out to Pencilstab on twitter (@speremint) and she very kindly gave me permission to upload my mod as long as I credited her properly. Thus, I restate that [b]I only made the sprites, the portraits are all Pencilstab's original work[/b].

Also, I haven't tested them for the beach, but if it works, he'll be wearing the same outfit there. Sorry, I'm no artist, I wasn't about to make a shirtless version of the portrait! XD I may at least make a white haired beach sprite, but that isn't my priority at present.

[b]To install: [/b]
1. Download the mod
2. Extract the contents, you should have a Portraits folder and a Sprites folder
3. Locate your Stardew Valley>Content>Portraits folder
4. Copy/move both of the files in the Portraits folder of the mod into the Portraits folder and [b]REPLACE [/b]them
5. Locate your Stardew Valley>Content>Characters folder
6. Copy/move both of the files in the Sprites folder of the mod into the Characters folder and [b]REPLACE[/b] them
7. Enjoy!!
